text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
1st place in the Yushun Himba (Oaks)! I 
managed to run the full 2,400m...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...However, it seems I had pushed far 
past my limits... and for quite a while, I 
found myself completely unable to stand 
back up."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Normally, the next race would be the Shuka 
Sho, but... Trainer told me that there's a 
completely different "stage" waiting for 
me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The sprint GⅠ, the Sprinters Stakes. All 
of a sudden, I ended up having to compete 
against the Senior class girls...!
